name: use_group
description: What the parcel or building is used for: current occupancy or taxation grouping (land and buildings)

name: use_subgroup
description: OpenPlaces use subgroup

name: use_group_combined
description: Combined use group and subgroup label

name: purpose_group
description: What the building was built (made) for; not applicable to unimproved land

name: purpose_subgroup
description: Building construction-purpose subgroup

name: purpose_group_combined
description: Combined purpose group and subgroup label

name: occupancy_type
description: Inferred occupancy: residential class (Single-Family / Multi-Family split into HAZUS Low/Mid/High-Rise bands by n_stories / Manufactured Home / RV Dwelling / Secondary) or NSI/parcel non-residential category; also the base for provenance-suffixed evidence variants attributed during harmonize (occupancy_type_building_nsi, occupancy_type_footprint_fema, ...) and curate (occupancy_type_parcel)

name: group
description: OpenPlaces top-level group

name: land_value
description: Assessed land value

name: land_value_imputed
description: Estimated land value for a parcel whose land value is missing or zero despite a positive improvement value and evidence it should carry one (residential land use, or footprint area disproportionate to its use_group_combined peers); a local per-area estimate (street+city cohort, then city-scoped, falling back to a county-wide residential-vs-non-residential average) times the parcel's own lot area

name: improvement_value
description: Assessed improvement value

name: other_value
description: Assessed value of items a roll counts in total_value but in neither land nor building (MassGIS OTHER_VAL: yard items such as sheds, pools and paving), so total = land + improvement + other

name: improvement_value_imputed
description: Improvement value re-derived as improvement_value minus land_value_imputed (clipped at 0), on the parcels land_value_imputed applies to

name: land_value_exempt
description: Assessed land value excluded from taxation (e.g. a tax-exempt owner)

name: land_value_taxable
description: Assessed land value actually subject to taxation

name: land_value_preferential
description: Land value under a preferential-use assessment program (e.g. Pennsylvania Act 319 "Clean and Green" agricultural/forest land)

name: improvement_value_exempt
description: Assessed improvement value excluded from taxation (e.g. a tax-exempt owner)

name: improvement_value_taxable
description: Assessed improvement value actually subject to taxation

name: land_value_prior_year
description: The roll's own land value for the tax year before its tax_year (e.g. HCAD prior_land_val); read by link_by_id's roll_values rule to fill a parcel the current year has not yet valued; not copied onto parcels

name: improvement_value_prior_year
description: The roll's own improvement value for the tax year before its tax_year (e.g. HCAD prior_bld_val); see land_value_prior_year

name: total_value_prior_year
description: The roll's own total value for the tax year before its tax_year (e.g. HCAD prior_tot_mkt_val); see land_value_prior_year

name: structure_value
description: Building's own assessed/replacement value, net of land: the parcel-apportioned improvement value or the NSI-modeled replacement value, chosen per admin unit by which source has usable coverage there, not per building; structure_value_building_nsi is the NSI-only evidence variant

name: year_built
description: Year building was built

name: address
description: Street address

name: address_conflict
description: Address evidence disagreement summary across sources (e.g. 'parcel: 789 ELM ST | dwelling_overture: 999 PINE ST'); null when the sources agree

name: postal_zip5
description: Normalized 5-digit ZIP code used for postal_city lookups

name: postal_city
description: USPS-preferred city name for postal_zip5

name: postal_city_acceptable
description: USPS-acceptable alternate city names for postal_zip5 (joined with '; ')

name: postal_city_unacceptable
description: USPS-unacceptable city names for postal_zip5 (joined with '; ')

name: land_area_sqft
description: Land area as the source states it (the lot, a condominium unit's stated land share, or its development's land), in sqft, as opposed to the geometry's own area_* columns

name: land_area_ac
description: Land area as the source states it (the assessor's record of the lot, a condominium unit's stated land share, or its development's land), in acres, as opposed to the deed's (area_deed_ac) or the geometry's own area_* columns

name: area_deed_ac
description: Parcel area per the recorded deed (as opposed to the assessor's record or computed geometry)

name: area_sqft
description: Own 2D area of the row's entity seen from above, in sqft (lot for a parcel, outline for a footprint)

name: n_stories
description: Number of stories

name: n_dwellings
description: Number of dwelling units in the building

name: height
description: Building height

name: n_sections
description: Number of factory-built sections joined on site to form the structure (1 single-wide, 2 double-wide, 3 triple-wide). Meaningful only for manufactured homes; missing for site-built structures

name: foundation_type
description: Foundation type code (B basement; C crawl; F fill; I pile; P pier; S slab; W solid wall)

name: construction_type
description: Structural construction material code (C concrete; H manufactured; M masonry; S steel; W wood)

name: roof_shape
description: Roof shape classification

name: roof_shape_confidence
description: Classifier confidence in roof_shape

name: roof_shape_2
description: Roof shape classification, second-ranked alternative

name: roof_shape_confidence_2
description: Classifier confidence in roof_shape_2

name: roof_shape_3
description: Roof shape classification, third-ranked alternative

name: roof_shape_confidence_3
description: Classifier confidence in roof_shape_3

name: has_garage
description: Whether the building has a garage

name: height_unconfirmed
description: True where the outline's value per sq ft of footprint is high (a tall drawn height) and its measured floors do not explain it (value per sq ft of floor above the flag's threshold); missing where the outline has no value

name: occupancy_type_base
description: Occupancy class before Multi-Family is split into height bands (pre-refinement occupancy_type)

name: occupancy_type_conflict
description: Occupancy evidence disagreement summary across all sources (e.g. 'nsi: X | fema: Y | parcel: Z'); null when the evidences agree

name: occupancy_type_review
description: Flag where improvement value is a small nonzero share of total value (possible manufactured home for review)

name: p_manufactured_home
description: Probability of manufactured home classification

name: manufactured_home_community
description: Flag where the parcel is classified as a manufactured-home community/park; footprints get the same-named, richer refinement of it (a parcel with more than the threshold count of manufactured-home footprints, per the final footprint occupancy)

name: n_manufactured_homes_per_parcel
description: Number of manufactured-home footprints on the footprint's parcel

name: n_primary_manufactured_homes_per_parcel
description: Number of footprints on the footprint's parcel that are primary on it and that the first occupancy vote classed Manufactured Home; read by the second pass on small secondary footprints

name: manufactured_home_rank_on_parcel
description: Rank of a footprint the first occupancy vote classed Manufactured Home among its parcel's such footprints, 1 for the largest by area_m2 (ties by footprint id); missing on every other footprint

name: n_manufactured_home_units
description: Number of mobile or manufactured home units the appraisal roll or building record lists for the property (one per improvement or building of a mobile-home type); 0 where the record lists buildings but none of that type, missing where the source records no unit types

name: n_travel_trailers
description: Number of travel trailers the appraisal roll lists as improvements of the property (a towable RV assessed as a dwelling unit); 0 where the roll lists other units, missing where the source records no such class

name: n_park_models
description: Number of park-model RVs the appraisal roll lists as improvements of the property; 0 where the roll lists other units, missing where the source records no such class

name: n_residential_buildings
description: Number of residential buildings (main-area improvements of a residential class, mobile homes and RVs included) the appraisal roll lists for the property; a structure count, not a dwelling-unit count

name: has_homestead_exemption
description: Whether the property carries a residence homestead exemption as the appraisal roll records it (Texas: the owner's principal residence)

name: land_use_class
description: Parcel land-use class: rule-based classes (e.g. Manufactured Home Park, RV Park, Townhome, Condominium, Vacant) with defaults voted from group_parcel/group_building_nsi/group_footprint_fema

name: n_footprints_per_parcel
description: Number of footprints on the parcel

name: n_small_elongated_footprints_per_parcel
description: Number of small elongated (manufactured-home-shaped) footprints on the parcel

name: n_primary_footprints_per_parcel
description: Number of non-accessory footprints on the parcel (excludes secondary/accessory structures)

name: max_footprint_area_m2
description: Largest footprint area on the parcel

name: footprint_area_m2_dominant
description: Total real (non-synthetic) footprint area on the parcel, summed from footprints for which this parcel is the dominant (largest-overlap) parcel -- each footprint's FULL, unclipped area, not the portion actually inside this parcel; can exceed the parcel's own area. See footprint_area_m2_in_parcel for a coverage-safe alternative.

name: footprint_area_m2_in_parcel
description: Real footprint area actually inside this parcel's own boundary: sum, per touching footprint, of its geometry clipped to this parcel (a real geometric intersection), across all footprints -- including non-dominant spillovers -- clearing min_overlap_m2 against this parcel. Bounded by the parcel's own area.

name: footprint_area_m2_primary
description: Total real (non-synthetic) footprint area on the parcel among non-secondary footprints, summed from footprints for which this parcel is the dominant parcel -- same unclipped-area caveat as footprint_area_m2_dominant.

name: footprint_area_share
description: Total footprint area as a share of the parcel's own total area

name: footprint_primary_area_share
description: Total non-secondary (non-accessory) footprint area as a share of the parcel's own total area (can exceed 1.0 for footprints straddling a parcel line -- footprint_area_m2_primary is unclipped)

name: max_parcels_per_footprint
description: Maximum number of parcels linked to any dwelling-confirmed primary footprint on the parcel (from the real, non-FEMA footprint spine)

name: max_dwellings_per_footprint
description: Maximum confirmed dwelling-unit count (Overture) on any single dwelling-confirmed primary footprint on the parcel

name: n_properties_per_parcel
description: Number of individual property/unit records grouped under this parcel, keyed by parcel_id_admin2. Exact where a native property-spine source exists (property_source='source' or 'shared_land_group'); estimated from confirmed footprint/dwelling multiplicity where none does (property_source='estimated')

name: property_source
description: Provenance of this parcel's property/unit count: 'source' (a real per-unit source table, e.g. MassGIS L3_ASSESS), 'shared_land_group' (geometrically inferred from a shared-land parcel group), 'estimated' (no per-unit source, but internal multiplicity evidence exists), or 'none'

name: shared_land_parcel_id
description: Index value of this parcel's shared-land group parcel (a near-zero-land-value parcel this one is entirely enclosed by, alongside >=1 other unit), where detect_shared_land_groups found one

name: year_first_buildup_hisdac
description: First build-up year from HISDAC FBUY raster

name: recorded_date
description: Date the deed was recorded at the registry

name: doc_type
description: Document/instrument type (e.g. deed warranty quitclaim)

name: instrument_number
description: Registry instrument number

name: book
description: Registry book number

name: page
description: Registry page number

name: grantor
description: Grantor (seller) name as recorded

name: grantee
description: Grantee (buyer) name as recorded

name: price
description: Transaction price

name: price_raw
description: Transaction price as provided by the source

name: sale_year
description: Year of the recorded sale

name: sale_month
description: Month of the recorded sale

name: sale_book
description: Official-record book of the recorded sale

name: sale_page
description: Official-record page of the recorded sale

name: sale_clerk_instrument
description: Clerk instrument number of the recorded sale

name: sale_qualification_code
description: The source's qualification of the sale (arm's length or a disqualification reason)

name: sale_multi_parcel
description: The source's flag that the sale covered several parcels

name: sale_vacant
description: Vacant or improved indicator at the sale

name: parcel_link_method
description: Which rules linked the sale to its parcels, '+'-joined where several did (a deed of several parcels): parcel_id_local (the standardized parcel number, tried first), stacked_units (a unit reaching its lot), assessor_last_sale (a parcel row's own last-sale field), then address_id_local_city, address_id_local and address_range (exact address keys, tried only where the number found nothing); missing where no rule did. A summary of the transaction-to-parcel link table's link_method; the name of a rule, never a score

name: sale_party_relationship
description: How the source says seller and buyer are related (e.g. Wisconsin RETR: No relationship, Financial, Shareholder/partner/member, Family, Other); a source field, never derived from names

name: sale_change_code
description: The source's code for a change to the sale record

name: transaction_id_source
description: The source's own identifier for the sale record

name: sale_document_id
description: Identifier of the recorded document (deed) behind the sale, spelled per source: a clerk instrument number, else book and page. Rows sharing it are one sale.

name: n_parcels_per_sale
description: Number of parcels the recorded document covered

name: sale_arms_length_confidence
description: Graded confidence that the sale was at arm's length, 0 to 1, from the signals the source supplies; a consumer sets its own cutoff

name: sale_qualification_group
description: The source's qualification of the sale as a group: qualified, qualified_parcel_changed, qualified_multi_parcel, pending, removed, disqualified, related_parties (Florida: relatives or affiliated companies), related_parties_family / _business / _financial / _unspecified (Wisconsin: the parties' own statement), not_a_sale (a gift, exchange or other conveyance)

name: sale_double_closing_earlier_leg
description: 1 where a second recorded document for the same parcel at the same price within a month follows this one (the earlier leg of a double closing), else 0; a consumer filters on it

name: sale_record_kind
description: Whether the record is a recorded deed or an assessor's last-sale field

name: sale_matches_deed
description: 1 where an assessor last-sale row has the same parcel, sale year, sale month and price as a recorded deed in the same admin unit (the deed's echo), 0 where it has none, missing on deed rows; a consumer filters on it

name: sale_price_to_assessed_ratio
description: Sale price over the assessed total value at the time of sale

name: sale_nominal_price_floor
description: The price at or below which this source records a nominal consideration rather than a price (Florida 100, North Carolina 0), read off the data as its largest low-price mass point

name: single_family_sales_disclosure_share
description: Share of single-family sales in the entity's admin unit with a disclosed price, a value for a consumer to threshold

name: parcel_id
description: Parcel identifier

name: parcel_id_all
description: All overlapping parcel identifiers (pipe-joined; dominant parcel first by descending intersection area; missing when identical to parcel_id)

name: parcel_id_admin2
description: Parcel identifier unique within its admin-2 unit

name: parcel_id_admin3
description: Parcel identifier unique within its admin-3 unit

name: parcel_id_admin4
description: Parcel identifier unique within its admin-4 unit

name: parcel_id_map
description: Parcel identifier from a secondary map/plat-based numbering system (e.g. VT's Grand List MAPID)

name: parcel_id_upi
description: Parcel's Uniform Parcel Identifier (UPI), where the source assigns one separately from its primary parcel id

name: parcel_id_cama
description: Computer-assisted mass appraisal (CAMA) system identifier for the parcel record

name: parcel_id_tax
description: Tax-roll parcel identifier (assessor PIN)

name: parcel_id_assessor
description: Raw parcel identifier as provided by the source

name: parcel_id_local
description: Standardized, locally cross-comparable parcel matching key

name: property_id_assessor
description: Raw property/unit identifier as provided by the source

name: property_id_admin2
description: Property/unit identifier unique within its admin-2 unit

name: lot_id_local
description: parcel_id_local of the lot a unit sits on, on property rows split off a parcel table at ingest; the row's own parcel_id_local stays the unit's

name: property_id_cama
description: Computer-assisted mass appraisal (CAMA) system identifier for the property/unit record

name: address_id_local
description: Standardized, town-scoped address matching key (no city component)

name: address_id_local_city
description: Standardized address matching key including city (only where city is available)

name: n_transactions
description: Number of recorded transactions on the parcel

name: type
description: Record or unit type or class

name: address_number
description: Street address number

name: address_street_name
description: Street name

name: address_street_type
description: Street type (St Ave Rd etc.)

name: address_street_directional
description: Street directional prefix or suffix (N S E W)

name: address_street
description: Street name with type and directional

name: address_unit_type
description: Address unit type (Apt Suite Unit etc.)

name: address_unit
description: Address unit or suite

name: city
description: City or place name

name: admin3_name
description: Raw admin-3 (county) name as given by the source

name: school_district_name
description: School district name

name: school_district_id
description: School district identifier or code

name: postal_code
description: Postal (ZIP) code

name: legal_description
description: Legal description of the property

name: subdivision
description: Subdivision name

name: subdivision_code
description: Subdivision code

name: owner_name
description: Owner name as recorded

name: owner_name_2
description: Second owner name as recorded

name: owner_name_january_1
description: Owner of record as of January 1 (the tax-roll assessment date)

name: owner_address
description: Owner mailing street address

name: owner_address_2
description: Owner mailing street address continuation line

name: owner_city
description: Owner mailing city

name: owner_state

name: owner_admin2_id_admin1
description: Owner mailing state/region as the level-2 admin id coded within admin1 (in-country)

name: owner_postal_code
description: Owner mailing postal (ZIP) code

name: owner_relationship

name: clean_and_green

name: zoning_code
description: Zoning classification code

name: tax_district

name: tax_year
description: Assessment or tax year

name: tax_neighborhood_code
description: Assessor neighborhood or market-area code

name: deed_reference

name: use_group_code
description: Source land-use code paired with use_group

name: use_subgroup_code
description: Source land-use code paired with use_subgroup

name: land_use_group
description: Source land-use group classification

name: total_value
description: Total assessed value: land plus structures. Named in full because a bare `value` reads as ambiguous on an entity that also carries land_value, improvement_value and structure_value

name: tax_value_gross
description: Gross property tax amount billed before credits/reductions (a tax bill amount not an assessed value)

name: tax_value_net
description: Net property tax amount billed after credits/reductions (a tax bill amount not an assessed value)

name: market_value
description: Market (just) value

name: special_feature_value
description: Assessed value of special features

name: current_use_value
description: Current-use (present-use) assessed value

name: personal_property_value
description: Assessed value of taxable personal property

name: classified_market_value
description: Classified (present-use) market value

description: Number of land units

description: Footprint area

description: Parcel lot area

name: temperature_mean_summer
description: Average temperature, Jun-Aug (30yr normal)

name: temperature_mean_winter
description: Average temperature, Dec-Feb (30yr normal)

name: coastal_water_share
description: Share of coastal waters within a radius

name: lake_distance
description: Distance from the parcel's primary building to the nearest lake at or above a size floor (4 ha by default; the recipe states it). Earlier values from the places model were a parcel-average raster distance

name: lake_frontage

name: river_frontage

name: lake_distance_parcel
description: Distance from the parcel's edge to the nearest lake at or above the size floor, 0 for a parcel touching one: the best building site, before setbacks

name: lake_id
description: NHD waterbody id of the largest lake the parcel fronts

name: lake_area_ha
description: Area of the largest lake the parcel fronts (NHD AreaSqKm)

name: lake_id_nearest
description: NHD waterbody id of the lake nearest the parcel's primary building (or its edge)

name: lake_area_ha_nearest
description: Area of the lake nearest the parcel's primary building (NHD AreaSqKm)

name: river_distance
description: Distance from the parcel's primary building to the nearest river polygon

name: river_distance_parcel
description: Distance from the parcel's edge to the nearest river polygon, 0 for a parcel touching one

name: waterbody_area_share

name: waterbody_id_nhd

name: waterbody_id_nhdplusv2

name: waterbody_id_hydrolakes

name: wetland_share

name: conservation_easement_share

name: travel_time_to_city
description: Travel time to nearest major city

name: household_income_median
description: Median household income

name: population_asian_share
description: Population share: Asian

name: population_black_share
description: Population share: Black/African-American

name: population_hispanic_share
description: Population share: Hispanic

name: population_mixed_race_share
description: Population share: mixed race

name: population_native_american_share
description: Population share: American Indian/Alaska Native

name: population_pacific_islander_share
description: Population share: Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander

name: population_gravity_index
description: Population gravity: decay-weighted residential population density from a building-footprint-distributed population raster

name: census_tract_id
description: Census tract identifier

name: county_fips
description: County FIPS code (5-digit state+county), read as the `county` segment of the unit's own national code rather than stored anywhere: outside New England it IS admin3_id_admin1, and in New England it is that column's first five characters. A federal identifier, so unlike admin3_id it survives an openplaces admin-id re-mint and stays joinable to Census, FEMA and other federal products

name: census_blockgroup_id
description: Census block group identifier

name: census_subdivision_id
description: Raw Census county subdivision (COUSUB) identifier for the containing admin4 unit

name: census_block_id
description: Census block identifier (2020 TIGER vintage)

name: zcta5_id
description: ZIP Code Tabulation Area (5-digit) identifier -- a Census statistical approximation of ZIP code service areas, not the authoritative ZIP code (see postal_zip5)

name: postal_code_conflict
description: ZIP-code evidence disagreement summary across sources feeding postal_zip5 (e.g. address-parsed vs. zcta5_id); null when sources agree

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb
description: Predicted land value per hectare (natural log, real USD, deflated to a reference date); 'region-nb' model

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb2
description: Same; 'region-nb2' model (alternate neighborhood-region spec)

name: aoa
description: Area of Applicability: rescaled dissimilarity to a model's training feature space (<=0 within domain, >0 extrapolation)

name: effective_year_built
description: Assessor's effective year built: the construction year implied by condition after improvements, not the actual one. Distinct from year_built and from renovation_year, and often the better-populated of the three

name: renovation_year
description: Year of the most recent recorded remodel or renovation

name: n_rooms
description: Number of rooms in the building

name: n_bedrooms
description: Number of bedrooms in the building

name: n_bathrooms
description: Number of bathrooms, each half bath counted as 0.5 (two full baths and one half bath read 2.5). A source that records quarter or three-quarter baths keeps them as 0.25 and 0.75. Where a source publishes full baths only, this is the full count; n_half_bathrooms carries the half count where the source separates it

name: n_half_bathrooms
description: Number of half bathrooms (a toilet and sink, no bath or shower), where the source records them separately. Each is already counted as 0.5 in n_bathrooms

name: heating_type
description: Heating system type as described by the source

name: has_basement
description: Whether the building has a basement

name: building_style
description: Architectural or construction style of the building as described by the source (e.g. ranch, conventional, double-wide). A structure descriptor, not a land use: do not map it to use_group

name: conveyance_type
description: What a recorded sale conveyed (e.g. land only vs land plus improvements). Distinct from doc_type, which is the instrument; the transaction-side counterpart of the parcel attribute last_sale_vacant

name: living_area_sqft
description: Finished, heated living area of the building as the assessor reports it (living, heated or finished area). Excludes garages, unfinished basements, porches and decks. Distinct from gross_floor_area_sqft (all enclosed floor area) and from area_sqft (the row's own 2D area seen from above, not a floor area)

name: gross_floor_area_sqft
description: Gross floor area: all enclosed floor area on all floors, including unfinished and non-living space (garage, unfinished basement), as the source reports it

name: quality_grade
description: Assessor's construction quality grade in the source's own codes (a letter or numeric class, e.g. 'C+' or '4'); not harmonized across sources

name: condition
description: Assessor's rating of the building's physical condition in the source's own codes (e.g. poor, fair, average, good); not harmonized across sources

name: exterior_wall
description: Exterior wall material as described by the source (e.g. brick, vinyl siding, stucco, frame)

name: roof_material
description: Roof covering material as described by the source (e.g. asphalt shingle, metal, tile); distinct from roof_shape

name: heating_fuel
description: Heating fuel as described by the source (e.g. gas, electric, oil, wood); distinct from heating_type, the system

name: has_central_air
description: Whether the building has central air conditioning

name: garage_type
description: Garage type as described by the source (e.g. attached, detached, built-in, basement)

name: n_garage_spaces
description: Number of garage parking spaces (car capacity)

name: garage_area_sqft
description: Garage floor area

name: detached_garage_area_sqft
description: Floor area of detached garages, kept out of gross_floor_area_sqft (a detached garage is usually its own footprint) so curate can add it back where no separate footprint exists for it

name: has_carport
description: Whether the property has a carport

name: n_parking_spaces
description: Number of off-street parking spaces as the source reports them (garage, carport, driveway or deeded spaces); common for urban lots and condominium units

name: basement_area_sqft
description: Basement floor area, finished and unfinished

name: basement_finished_area_sqft
description: Finished part of the basement floor area

name: has_pool
description: Whether the property has a swimming pool as the source records it

name: n_fireplaces
description: Number of fireplaces as the source counts them (openings or stacks)

name: porch_area_sqft
description: Porch floor area, open and enclosed

name: deck_area_sqft
description: Deck and patio area

name: has_elevator
description: Whether the building has a passenger elevator

name: n_outbuildings
description: Number of detached accessory structures the source records (sheds, barns, detached garages)

name: has_solar
description: Whether the property has solar panels as the source records it

name: has_accessory_dwelling
description: Whether the property has a secondary dwelling unit (accessory dwelling, in-law unit, garage apartment)

name: unit_floor
description: Floor a condominium or apartment unit sits on, numbered as the source numbers it

name: sewer_type
description: Sewage disposal as described by the source (e.g. public sewer, septic)

name: water_source
description: Water supply as described by the source (e.g. public, private well)

name: frontage_ft
description: Lot frontage along the street

name: has_waterfront
description: Whether the lot fronts on a water body as the source records it

name: view_rating
description: Assessor's view rating in the source's own codes (for a condominium unit, the unit's view); not harmonized across sources

name: topography
description: Lot topography as described by the source (e.g. level, rolling, steep)

name: construction_description
description: Structural construction or frame type in the source's own words or codes (e.g. frame, masonry, wood; a county's class letters). Kept as the county defines it; curate translates it into construction_type

name: foundation_description
description: Foundation type in the source's own words or codes (e.g. slab, crawl space, full basement). Kept as the county defines it; curate translates it into foundation_type

name: dwelling_type_description
description: Dwelling or unit type in the source's own words or codes (e.g. standard, end unit, garden condo, mobile home, parking space). Kept as the county defines it; curate translates it into occupancy and attachment indicators
